p.m.

Encinitas, California 92024

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the July 13, 2016 Closed Session Meeting, July 13, 2016 Regular Meeting, July 13, 2016 Special Meeting, July 20, 2016 Regular Meeting, and July 27, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-08-17 Item 08A Minutes

2016-08-17 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Designation of a voting delegate and a voting delegate-alternate for the League of California Cities (LCC) Annual Conference, October 5-7, 2016. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2016-78 designating Mayor Gaspar to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate and City Manager Brust as a voting delegate-alternate at the LCC Annual Conference in October 2016.
2016-08-17 Item 08C Voting Delegate for the League of California Cities Conference
8D.
Dedication of Sewer Easement to San Elijo Powers Authority (SEJPA) for their sewer outfall across Assessor Parcel Number (APN) 261-191-04. Contact Person: Engineer Hefner
Approve a sewer easement dedication to San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) across APN 261-191-04, and authorize the Director of Public Works to execute this sewer easement with the SEJPA.
2016-08-17 Item 08D Sewer Easement Dedication
8E.

1) Accept the public improvements; and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2016-08-17 Item 08E City Hall Sewer Rehabilitation (CF15A)
8F.

1) Accept the public improvements; and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2016-08-17 Item 08F Construction Completion of Annual Storm Drain Rehabilitation (CD05E)
8G.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and EXPOSURE Skate for a Community Special Event. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
Approve a one-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for a second year between the City of Encinitas and EXPOSURE Skate to provide a major special skate event scheduled for Saturday, November 5, 2016, with November 6 as a back-up rain date at Encinitas Community Park.
2016-08-17 Item 08G Exposure Skate Memorandum of Understanding
8H.
Participation in the Beacon Program. Contact Person: Acting Climate Action Plan Program Administrator Najera

2016-08-17 Item 08H Participation in the Beacon Program
8I.

Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-83 entitled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2016-17 Adopted Budgetâ€.
2016-08-17 Item 08I Expanded Polystyrene Engagement Services Budget Authorization
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.

Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2016-07, which proposes changes to the Cityâ€™s density bonus ordinance. The proposed ordinance will amend the Cityâ€™s zoning regulations and Local Coastal Program. Project No. 16-145 POD. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Conduct the public hearing; and 3) Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2016-07 titled, â€œAn Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Chapter 30.16.020.C (Density Bonus Regulations) of the Encinitas Municipal Codeâ€ as reflected in Attachment CC-1 for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
